risparmiare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

risparmio.consejo: First person or substantive of economy.

texto: **Siccome piove, restiamo a casa** = The determining reason to stay is the present rain.
**Studio con impegno per superare l'esame** = The purpose and goal that guides the effort is to pass the test.

filas: Siccome fa freddo, accendiamo il riscaldamento.
As it's cold, we turn on the heating.
Non esco perché devo terminare un lavoro urgente.
I don't go out because I have to finish an urgent job.
Risparmio denaro per comprare una nuova casa.
I save money to buy a new home.
Lavoriamo insieme al fine di migliorare i servizi.
We work together to improve services.

frases.it: Perché studi fino a tarda notte questa settimana?
frases.es: ¿Por qué estudias hasta altas horas de la noche esta semana?
frases.en: Why are you studying until late tonight?
analisis: up to high hours of the night

frases.it: Studio molte ore per superare l'esame di certificazione a pieni voti.
frases.es: Estudio muchas horas para superar el examen de certificación con matrícula.
frases.en: I study many hours to pass the certificate exam with registration.

frases.it: E siccome la biblioteca chiude presto, ti fermi a casa?
frases.es: ¿Y como la biblioteca cierra temprano, te quedas en casa?
frases.en: And when the library closes early, you stay home?

frases.it: Esatto: resto nella mia stanza per concentrarmi meglio senza distrazioni.
frases.es: Exacto: me quedo en mi habitación para concentrarme mejor sin distracciones.
frases.en: Exactly, I'm staying in my room to concentrate better without distractions.

bloques.pregunta: What connector introduces the goal or goal that Matteo pursues with his effort?

opciones.texto: La preposición «per» seguida de infinitivo simple («per superare l'esame»).
opciones.explicacion: Canonical expression of the Italian purpose supplement.

opciones.texto: La conjunción causal «siccome» al principio de su réplica.
El adverbio interrogativo «perché» que formula preguntas.
opciones.explicacion: It is used to demand the reason, not to state the purpose itself.

bloques.frase: Ho acquistato questo vocabolario specialistico ___ migliorare la mia scrittura.

opciones.explicacion: Rige the infinitive «migliorare» expressing the purpose pursued.
It would require a verb in personal mode conjugated with indicative or congiuntive.
It would indicate a cause and cannot immediately precede an infinitive target.

bloques.frase: Siccome piove a dirotto, abbiamo deciso di restare al calduccio in casa.

opciones.texto: He explains that intense rain is the cause that motivated the decision to stay at home.
opciones.explicacion: Prior cause formulated at the beginning of the wording.

opciones.texto: He plans to stay at home and he's gonna start raining.
opciones.explicacion: The relationship between cause and purpose is illogical.

opciones.texto: It expresses an unlikely condition referred to next week.
opciones.explicacion: It does not contain any conditional assumptions.

bloques.pregunta: What syntactic feature differs «perché» from «per» when expressing targets?

opciones.texto: «Perché» causal rige verbo conjugado; «per» de finalidad rige infinitivo cuando el sujeto coincide.
opciones.explicacion: Basic syntactic rule of subordination in Italian.

opciones.texto: «Per» sólo puede utilizarse con sustantivos de cantidad económica.
opciones.explicacion: False: is used with endless purpose infinities.
It is the conjunction of causal response par excellence.

bloques.frase: Studio ogni giorno per superare l'esame
bloques.traduccion: Study each day to pass the test
bloques.explicacion: Order the final prayer with infinitive.

bloques.frase: Abbiamo prenotato con largo anticipo ___ trovare posti migliori a teatro.

opciones.explicacion: Enter the purpose of the advance procedure using the «trovare» infinitive.
A causal connector that does not conceive with meta infinitive.
A consecutive marker that would require independent conjugated verb.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «As it's cold, we stay home.»?

opciones.texto: Siccome fa freddo, restiamo a casa.
opciones.explicacion: «Siccome» opens the causal prayer with perfect nature.

opciones.texto: Per fa freddo, restiamo a casa.
opciones.explicacion: «Per» cannot join a conjugated verb in indicative.

opciones.texto: Quindi fa freddo, restiamo a casa.
opciones.explicacion: Misuse of the ilative following the start of the case.

intro: In the argument it is essential not to confuse the **causa** (why a situation occurs in the past or present) of the **finalidad** (for which purpose it is acted towards the future). In Italian the cause is formulated with **siccome** or **perché**, while the purpose is expressed with **per + infinito** or **affinché + congiuntivo**.
